title: Nobel Peace Prize goes to South African human rights pioneer Navi Pillay - CNN
description: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Navi Pillay led the UN commission that concluded Israel committed genocide against Palestinians in Gaza. President Donald Trump has repeatedly claimed he deserves to win. Follow for live updates.

title: F1 Singapore GP: George Russell on top, Max Verstappen sets impressive lap - Motorsport.com
description: Russell may have topped FP1 in Singapore, but Verstappen led the medium-tyre runners by some margin

title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says - BBC
description: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

title: Poll: 1 in 4 Trump voters say GOP candidates should break from the president - Politico
description: It’s notable that so many who backed the president are ready for Republicans to take that leap, amid an unpopular war in Iran and high costs of living.
